data.safe_summary: External and agent-created skills are discovery signals only until quarantined, reviewed, converted into UAA-owned adaptations, and separately granted activation authority.

stages.safe_summary: Stars, downloads, reviews, screenshots, and publisher claims are discovery signals only, never trust.
External or agent-created skill ideas are quarantined before review.
Review captures source, safety, license, product fit, and blocked authority posture without running external code.
Adaptation proposals are diffs or plans for UAA-owned work, not automatic skill writes.
Only reviewed UAA-owned adaptations can later request activation grants.
Activation remains blocked until manifest, scan, approval, receipts, rollback, and safe-disable posture are proven.
External skill execution, direct marketplace install, and runtime import remain blocked.
